findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: REPEAT Inspector observed the cook line sanitizer bucket to have < 100 PPM of quat sanitizer. Discussed with PIC. PIC stated the sanitizer was made early this morning and immediately switched it out with a fresh bucket measuring 200 PPM. Ensure sanitizer concentration is checked regularly to maintain sanitization in facility.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
REPEAT Inspector observed two areas in need of re-caulking

1. The caulk attaching the triple sink to the wall is cracking and in need of replacement. There are soils present in the caulk as well. Discussed with PIC. Ensure caulk is replaced to create a smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable surface.

2. The caulk attaching the mop sink to the wall was observed to have a build up of soils and be cracking as well. Discussed with PIC. Ensure caulk is replaced to create a smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket was observed to have a concentration of 100 ppm (q).  Discuss with PIC, corrected on-site.  Ensure sanitizer buckets are changed more often to maintain the proper sanitizing concentration of 200 ppm.

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
The hand sink by the walk-in cooler drips from the faucet.  Ensure the faucet is repaired and maintained in good working order.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Areas in need of resealing or re-caulking to the wall include:
-(REPEAT) The women’s bathroom hand sink
-(REPEAT) The far hand sink located by the door to the dining area
-(NEW) The men’s bathroom sink
-(NEW) The 3 part sink
-(NEW) The mop sink
-(NEW) The other 2 hand sinks
Ensure these areas are sealed to prevent mold growth and create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
